Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
I wanted to remind anyone interested they can contribute to the TWD by submitting  pull requests to the TWD repository: github.com/GiottoVerducci/TWD.

Please insert the link of the TWD post(s) on this forum in the description of the pull request.

Posts that have a green mark have already been added. Only posts without any topic icon should be submitted after verifying they are not already present in the TWD.

Thanks for the help.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
